title: This app makes the Pixel 11’s HiLight feature actually useful
summary: Google’s new HiLight notification LED on the Pixel 11 Pro is nearly useless. X user Dhananjay_Tech developed a new app called HiLight Studio , which lets you do practically anything you want with the HiLight LED array.
